title: AI Lead Engineers
description:
About the job

* About TechjaysTechjays is an AI-first technology company focused on building innovative, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions for global clients. We combine advanced AI capabilities with strong software engineering practices to solve real-world business challenges.At Techjays, we believe in building beyond prototypes. We focus on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable AI-powered products that create measurable business impact.Role OverviewWe are looking for an experienced AI Lead Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI applications. The ideal candidate will have strong backend engineering expertise, hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), and practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic AI systems.You will take ownership of AI solutions from architecture and development through deployment and optimization, while mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence across projects.Key ResponsibilitiesLead the architecture, design, development, and deployment of production-grade AI applications.
* Build and optimize Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI frameworks.
* Design scalable backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and AI-integrated applications using Python.
* Develop document processing, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and context-aware AI systems.
* Work with vector databases and embedding models to build efficient retrieval pipelines.
* Implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph and CrewAI.
* Integrate AI models and services with existing enterprise applications, databases, and cloud platforms.
* Make architectural decisions covering scalability, performance, security, reliability, and cost optimization.
* Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve AI solutions in production environments.
* Establish best practices for coding standards, testing, CI/CD, observability, and AI application development.
* Mentor engineers, conduct code reviews, and guide the team on technical decisions.
* Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them to real-world business problems.
* Required Technical SkillsProgramming and Backend EngineeringStrong proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming.
* Experience with FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous programming, and scalable system design.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, caching, and data modeling.
* Generative AI and LLMsHands-on experience building applications using LLMs and Generative AI.
* Strong practical understanding of RAG architecture, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and prompt engineering.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, hallucination reduction, context management, and production performance optimization.
* Cloud and DeploymentExperience deploying AI applications on AWS or GCP.
* Proficiency in Docker, Linux, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of application monitoring, logging, security, and production troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud architectures.
* System Design and LeadershipStrong system design and architectural decision-making skills.
* Experience leading technical projects and owning end-to-end solution delivery.
* Ability to mentor engineers, review code, and drive engineering best practices.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* What We’re Looking For7–10+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, AI engineering, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI-powered applications into production.
* Strong backend engineering fundamentals combined with practical Generative AI expertise.
* Ability to explain architectural choices, trade-offs, and implementation decisions.
* A hands-on technical leader who can guide a team while actively contributing to development.
* Experience using AI development tools and coding assistants as part of everyday engineering workflows.
* A strong ownership mindset, with the ability to independently solve complex technical problems.
* What Success Looks LikeDelivering scalable, reliable, production-ready AI applications.
* Building robust RAG and Agentic AI solutions beyond proof-of-concept implementations.
* Improving system performance, response quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Enabling the engineering team through technical leadership, mentoring, and best practices.
* Translating business requirements into measurable AI-driven outcomes.
* Why Join Techjays?Work on real-world AI products and enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Collaborate with a team building AI-first solutions for global clients.
* Take ownership of architecture, engineering decisions, and end-to-end delivery.
* Work with emerging AI technologies and solve challenging technical problems.
* Contribute to a culture that values innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

title: SAP BDC-DSP-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Senior:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join a high-performing SAP Analytics and Data team to help organizations unlock business value through data-driven insights. As an SAP BDC Consultant, you will work on designing, developing, and implementing enterprise data and analytics solutions using SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and related technologies. You will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, innovative, and high-quality data solutions that support strategic decision-making.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, and SAP BW/4HANA data models.
* Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Build and optimize data pipelines, transformations, and integration processes.
* Develop analytical models, reports, and dashboards using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
* Integrate SAP and non-SAP data sources to support enterprise analytics requirements.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.
* Support data governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with business users, architects, and project teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize data models and reporting solutions.
* Prepare technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, and SAP Business Data Cloud concepts.
* Experience in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehousing principles.
* Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) reporting and planning capabilities.
* Understanding of SAP S/4HANA data structures and analytical content.
* Experience with SQL, SAP HANA modelling, and data integration techniques.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in Agile delivery methodologies.
* Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail and quality.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* SAP certifications in Datasphere, BW/4HANA, SAC, or related SAP technologies.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, or other SAP functional domains.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr Support Engineer 1 - BY TMS/ Blue Yonder Transportation Management
description:

* Leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* Seeking an astute individual that has a strong Supply Chain/Warehouse domain experience and technical knowledge with the additional ability to be hands-on with the broader teams as part of the development/deployment and maintenance cycle, and good knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with customers and internal platform, and the product teams.

* Core responsibilities include understanding the customer requests, supporting our designed products / solutions to efficiently satisfy business requirements, while balancing complexity to ensure processes are supportable and meet customer satisfaction.
* The team currently comprises of 100+ global associates across geographies and is expected to grow. The incumbent will need to have leadership qualities to also mentor junior and mid-level support engineers in our team.

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* Software: Java, GIT, Rest API, OAuth, PL/SQL
* Application Architecture: Scalable, Resilient, event driven, secure multi-tenant Microservices architecture
* Cloud Architecture: MS Azure (ARM templates, AKS, Application gateway, Virtue Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD)
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Spark, NOSQL, RDBMS, Springboot, Gradle GIT, Ignite

**What You’ll Do**

* BY TMS (TMS – Transportation Management System) Support Engineer will be responsible to work with global technical and functional teams under various customer engagements.
* Individual will work with region customers/stakeholders to understand the request, support our designed products / solutions to efficiently satisfy business requirements, while balancing complexity to ensure processes are supportable and meet customer satisfaction.
* Individual to gather and understand the functional reported issues/problems and drive towards solutions and fixes, adhering to defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
* Document learnings and create knowledge articles for repeated cases
* Replicate and maintain customer environments
* Maintain knowledge of customer solution and customization
* Maintain sense of urgency and swiftness with all customer interactions
* Improve Customer Satisfaction by providing quality and timely solutions to reported issues and follow-up until closure.
* Interact with internal and external stakeholders and reports to management.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Individuals should be passionate about working with new technologies and products.
* Demonstrate ability to learn quickly, have good interpersonal & communication skills– verbal and written.
* Drive architecture and designs to become simpler, more robust, and more efficient.
* Confidently represents product and portfolio, including vision and functional and technical roadmaps, within the company and, when necessary, to strategic customers

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree (STEM preferred) and minimum 3 to 7 years of experience in Application Support and Implementation; ideally a candidate had experience of supporting BY TMS - SCM applications and aware of Architecture, Basics of Integration, Apache /IIS and working on the product support, within the last 3-4 years minimum.
* Strong experience of supporting BY TMS Web-application: Understanding of WMS application, architecture, experience in configuration and troubleshooting of BY TMS.
* Demonstrable experience supporting and maintenance of enterprise cloud solutions (we use Azure)
* Demonstrable experience with microservices based architecture on Cloud.
* Demonstrable experience, thorough knowledge and interests in Cloud native architecture, Distributed micro-services, Multi-tenant SaaS solution and Cloud Scalability, performance and High availability.
* Experience with varied tools such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, JIRA, AppD, Splunk.
* Good Understanding of secure architectures, secure configuration, identity management,

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Developer III - Embedded Software
description:
**Role Description**
Embedded Firmware developer Activities Involved: Design, develop, and implement embedded software for microcontrollers and microprocessors. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in Embedded C and other relevant programming languages. Conduct software testing and debugging to ensure functionality and performance. Optimize software for performance, memory usage, and power consumption. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers. Document software design, architecture, and user manuals. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies related to embedded systems. Troubleshoot and resolve software issues in a timely manner. Must be familiarized in controller peripherals like Timer, PWM, DMA, External memory interface etc. Should have good understanding about communication interfaces like SPI, I2C, USART and USB. Good experience in C and Embedded C programming Must be expertise in tools like compiler, linker and loader. Should be good in build system scripting. Make / Cmake. Should have handled test equipment like multimeter, logic analyzer, debuggers etc. Good experience in Python (modules like numpy, pandas, etc.) programming for data visualization and validation Good understanding of Sensor system solutions like accelerometers, gyroscope, etc. Basic knowledge in signal processing Experience on MEMS sensors, FPGA. Furthermore, a familiarity with ASICS, SystemC models Experience with Agile development processes (Scrum) and tools Ability to work with cross functional teams and gather requirements
  
  
**Skills**
C, Embedded Systems, Python, FPGA, DMA, MEMS Sensors, USB, SPI, Sensors, I2C, USART

**Job Description**
We are looking for a skilled
**Zoho Administrator**
to manage, configure, automate, and optimize Zoho applications used across our ISP/Telecom operations. The role will be responsible for administration, workflow automation, user management, integrations, reporting, and troubleshooting across platforms such as
**Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Zoho Desk, Zoho People, Zoho Creator, and other Zoho One applications**
.
  
  

* Zoho Administration:
* Create and manage users, roles, profiles, permissions, territories, and security settings.
* Configure modules, fields, layouts, views, forms, and business rules.
* Manage user access and application-level permissions.
* Monitor system performance and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Administer and maintain Zoho applications and Zoho One environment
* Zoho CRM Management
* Configure \*Zoho CRM\* based on sales, customer service, and ISP business requirements.
* Manage Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, Activities, and custom modules.
* Configure lead assignment, sales pipelines, approval processes, and automation.
* Maintain data quality, duplicate management, and CRM records.
* Develop dashboards and reports for management and department heads.
* Workflow & Automation
* Design and implement automated business workflows using \*Zoho Workflow Rules, Blueprints, Functions, Schedules, and Approvals\*.
* Develop automation for customer onboarding, sales processes, service requests, collections, renewals, and internal approvals.
* Identify manual processes and recommend automation opportunities.
* Troubleshoot and optimize existing automation.
* Deluge Development
* Develop custom functions using \*Deluge scripting\*.
* Create custom business logic and automated actions.
* Work with API calls, webhooks, custom functions, and third-party integrations.
* Debug and optimize Deluge scripts and automation.
* ISP/Telecom Business Process Support
* Configure Zoho applications to support \*ISP customer acquisition, installation, activation, billing, support, complaints, and renewal processes\*.
* Support workflows related to FTTH/FTTx, broadband, leased lines, enterprise customers, and service operations.
* Coordinate with Sales, HR, Finance, Customer Support, Network, and Operations teams to understand business requirements.
* Translate operational requirements into scalable Zoho solutions.
* Integration & API Management
* Integrate Zoho applications with internal and third-party systems using \*APIs, webhooks, and connectors\*.
* Work with systems such as payment gateways, billing platforms, websites, customer portals, attendance systems, and other business applications.
* Monitor integration failures and troubleshoot data synchronization issues.
* Reporting & Dashboards
* Create MIS reports, dashboards, KPIs, and management reports.
* Develop department-wise reports for Sales, Operations, Finance, HR, and Customer Support.
* Automate recurring reports and notifications.
* Ensure accurate and timely business data.
* User Support & Troubleshooting
* Provide technical support to Zoho users.
* Resolve configuration, access, workflow, automation, and data-related issues.
* Conduct user training and prepare basic process documentation.
* Maintain a record of recurring issues and implement preventive solutions.
* Data Management & Security
* Maintain data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across Zoho applications.
* Manage data import/export and migration activities.
* Configure appropriate access controls and security policies.
* Follow backup, data retention, and information-security practices.
* Documentation & Continuous Improvement
* Document configurations, workflows, custom functions, integrations, and processes.
* Maintain technical documentation for Zoho applications.
* Evaluate new Zoho features and recommend improvements.
* Continuously optimize Zoho systems to improve operational efficiency.

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Zoho administration, Deluge scripting, workflow automation, API integrations, dashboards, and business process optimization.
  
  
**Technical Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of Zoho CRM Administration.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho One.
* Good knowledge of Deluge scripting.
* Experience with Zoho Workflow Rules, Blueprints, Functions, Approvals, and Schedules.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, Webhooks, and API integrations.
* Experience in creating custom modules, fields, layouts, reports, and dashboards.
* Knowledge of data import/export and data migration.
* Troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* ISP/Telecom Domain Knowledge – Preferred
* Understanding of ISP/Telecom business processes.
* Knowledge of FTTH/FTTx, broadband, leased line, installation, activation, service requests, complaints, and customer lifecycle is an advantage.
* Understanding of Sales → Installation → Activation → Billing → Support → Renewal processes is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Willingness to learn new Zoho applications and technologies.
* Any Degree / B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / Equivalent IT qualification.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in Zoho Administration, Zoho CRM, Zoho One, Automation, or Deluge Development.
* Experience in ISP / Telecom / IT / SaaS / Technology-driven organizations will be preferred.
* Strong experience in API integrations and third-party app connectivity.
* Ability to manage user roles, security, and data governance.Strong troubleshooting and cross-module knowledge.
* Zoho certification(s) in CRM, Creator, or allied modules.
* Ability to train staff on Zoho application usage and best practices.
* Familiarity with data migration and backup procedures in Zoho.

**Benefits**

* Competitive Salary Package.
* Statutory Benefits
* Complimentary Lunch.
* Career Development & Growth Opportunities.
* Annual Performance-Based Appraisal.
* Professional Learning & Development Opportunities.
* Supportive & Collaborative Work Environment

Zoho Administrator,Zoho CRM, Zoho One, Zoho Creator, Zoho Books, Zoho Desk, Zoho People, Deluge, Zoho Automation, Workflow Automation, API Integration, REST API, Webhooks, Zoho Functions, Blueprints, CRM Administration, Business Process Automation, Zoho Integration

title: AI Evaluation Lead (Part Time Contract, Engagement Based)
description:
**About us**

DATACLAP is an AI data services company based in Coimbatore, working with AI companies across North America and Europe on data annotation, human in the loop workflows, RLHF and MLOps. We're building a dedicated AI evaluation practice covering LLMs, AI agents, computer vision and audio models, and we're looking for experienced practitioners to lead client engagements and mentor our engineering team.

**The role**

This is a part time, engagement based contract role, not full time employment. You'll lead AI evaluation projects for our clients, typically 8 to 15 hours a week per engagement. You'll design the evaluation approach, guide a team of junior engineers who do the hands on execution, review their work, and own the quality of what we deliver. You'll also help us turn every engagement into reusable methods, so the practice gets stronger with each project.

**What you'll do**

* Scope evaluation projects with clients: understand the model, the use case, and what "good" looks like for them
* Design evaluation frameworks, including metrics, test sets, rubrics, and pass/fail criteria
* Build or guide the building of golden datasets and evaluation harnesses
* Design and calibrate LLM as a judge setups, and know when human evaluation is needed instead
* Plan red teaming, safety and robustness testing where relevant
* Lead and mentor 2 to 5 junior engineers per engagement through regular reviews and working sessions
* Review results, catch flawed methodology, and present findings to client stakeholders
* Document each engagement as a playbook, rubric set or template the team can reuse

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in machine learning, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years focused on model evaluation, benchmarking or quality assurance of ML systems
* Hands on experience evaluating LLM applications: RAG systems, chatbots, agents or fine tuned models
* Solid grounding in evaluation fundamentals: metric selection, test set design, statistical significance, inter annotator agreement, and data leakage
* Experience with eval tooling such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, Inspect, Langfuse, Braintrust or EleutherAI's evaluation harness (or custom built equivalents)
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, and comfort reviewing others' work critically
* Clear written and spoken communication; you'll present findings to international clients
* Python proficiency

**Strong plus**

* Computer vision evaluation experience (detection, segmentation, tracking; metrics such as mAP and IoU; tools such as FiftyOne or CVAT)
* Audio or speech model evaluation (word error rate, speaker diarization, MOS style human ratings)
* Experience with AI agent evaluation: task completion, tool use, multi step trajectories
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF
* Prior consulting or client facing delivery experienc
  **e**

* If you're currently employed, please make sure your employer permits outside consulting work

title: Workload Automation Consultant
description:
As a Workload Automation Consultant, you will be the primary customer-facing advisor for our internal business units. Instead of maintaining backend platform infrastructure, your mission is to design intelligent, application-level workflows, eliminate manual touchpoints, and pioneer AI-driven automation innovations directly with our customers.

Focus Area: Customer-Facing Solution Design, Application-Level Workflow Orchestration, AI & Hyperautomation Innovation

Target Mindset: "Automate Everything" – A proactive, highly motivated specialist who views manual intervention as a bug and is passionate about driving cognitive automation.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Advanced Redwood RunMyJobs certifications (preferred).

**Additional Information**

**Mindset & Soft Skills**

* The "Automate Everything" DNA: You have a strong bias for action and a passion for finding automated solutions to manual problems. You strive for 100% hands-off execution.
* Consultative & Client-Facing: Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. You can comfortably bridge the gap between technical developers and non-technical business partners.
* Growth Mindset: Highly motivated to continuously learn, experiment with emerging tech (like GenAI and LLMs), and challenge the status quo.

**Technical Profile**

* Workload Automation Expertise: Strong practical experience in designing and configuring application workflows in enterprise systems such as Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ), Broadcom Automic (UC4) or similar workload automation tools.
* Scripting & APIs: Proven proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell, or JavaScript) and working with REST/SOAP APIs to integrate disparate systems.
* AI & Automation Tools: Familiarity or hands-on experience with AI/ML concepts, Generative AI APIs, or Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools is highly desirable.
* No Infrastructure Overhead: Understanding of OS architectures (Linux, Windows) is required, but you are excited that your core focus is on delivering business value at the application layer, not server maintenance.

title: Technical Consultant -BY SCPO, Demand & Fulfilment
description:
**Scope**

* This is a technical position within a leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions SaaS Product Company and one of Glassdoor's "Best Places to Work." The role requires an astute individual with a strong technical foundation who can collaborate with a broader engineering team to drive the development, deployment cycle, and implementation of industry best practices.

**Key Focus Areas**

* Customer Implementation & Support: Providing functional and technical support during customer upgrades, deployments, and rollouts, and maintaining positive relationships by resolving conflicts and managing expectations.
* Deep Technical Troubleshooting: Working closely with solution experts for complex issue resolution, including code development, and continuous learning on the latest planning solutions.
* SaaS Product Enablement: Bringing in ideas for automation, features, and service improvements, and setting up new product features for deployed customers. Essential Requirements (Experience & Technical Stack):
* Experience: 6+ years in the Software/SaaS industry, 3+ years in the supply chain domain, and experience with customer support in Supply Chain software.
* Mandatory Technical Skills: Expert knowledge of database programming using Oracle SQL/MS SQL, operating systems (UNIX, Windows), programming (e.g., C#, ASP.Net), and scripting languages (Unix Shell, Python, Perl, etc.).
* Domain Preference: Ideal candidates will have technical/demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder Planning Suite solutions, specifically SCPO (ESP, Demand, Fulfillment, Promotions, Inventory Optimization, etc.).
* Soft Skills: The role requires excellent communication, strong multi-tasking, the ability to work calmly under pressure, and a self-motivated, quick-learner mindset, often involving flexible work hours to meet customer escalations.

**Overview**

* Leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* Blue Yonder is the world leader in digital supply chain transformations and omni-channel commerce fulfillment. Our end-to-end, cognitive business platform enables retailers, manufacturers and logistics providers to best fulfill customer demand from planning through delivery. With Blue Yonder, you’ll unify your data, supply chain and retail commerce operations to unlock new business opportunities and drive automation, control and orchestration to enable more profitable, sustainable business decisions. Blue Yonder - Fulfill your Potential™
* Seeking an astute individual that has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands-on with the broader engineering team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform and the product teams.

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* OS – Unix, Windows 2008R2 and above.
* Supply chain products: SCPO (Demand & FF, ESP, Promotions, IO, S&OP)
* RDBMS – Oracle 11g and above and SQL/PLSQL 2012 and above, Snowflake
* BA tools – Cognos.
* SaaS Platform – Azure, Parallel Client
* Interface: SFTP, AS2, DMS, Blue Yonder connect
* Scripting – Perl, Shell, Python is desirable.
* Scheduling tools knowledge – Control-M is preferred

**Software/Tools**

* MS SQL Server, Visual Code, Visual Studio, Jira, GIT, AI tools(Co-Pilot, Cursor, Claude etc), Confluence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Provide functional and/or technical support during customer upgrades, deployments, rollouts, and post-production phases.
* For developing modification the candidate should be able to drive end to end by having requirement understanding discussion, functional and technical design document creation, developing high quality code using coding best practices, unit testing, packaging code and deployment.
* Maintain positive customer relationships by resolving conflicts and issues, managing expectations, and instilling confidence in Blue Yonder Planning Solution Operate Team
* Provide advice to Blue Yonder partners and customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology as well as reviewing their code.
* Document learnings and creating knowledge articles for repeated cases.
* Bring in new ideas for automation, reusable items and service improvements.
* Understand the SaaS offering, features and functionality deployed for a given customer.
* Work closely with the Blue Yonder Planning SCPO Solution Experts for complex issue resolution including Product Development.
* Continuous learning on latest Blue Yonder Planning Solutions.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Industry experience:
* 6+ years of experience in the Software/SaaS industry

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Role: Solution Architect – Semantic Governance AI Platform
   

 Engagement: Project / Contract / Strategic Collaboration
   

 Experience: 8\+ years preferred
   

 Domain: Enterprise Data Governance \| AI/ML \| Semantic Architecture \| Knowledge Graphs
   

 Location: Remote / Hybrid
   

  

 About the Project
   

  

 We are building an enterprise Semantic Governance AI Platform that establishes authoritative business definitions, manages semantic conflicts, maintains regulatory and decision provenance, and ensures approved definitions are consistently implemented across data warehouses, BI platforms, ML systems and enterprise applications.
   

  

 The platform will integrate with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Collibra/Alation and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can own the end\-to\-end technical architecture and work closely with business stakeholders, Data Governance teams, Data Scientists, Data Engineers and development teams.
   

  

 The architect will translate business governance requirements into a scalable architecture covering semantic modeling, workflow, AI, knowledge graphs, integrations, security, APIs and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture
   

  

 \* Design the end\-to\-end architecture for the Semantic Governance Platform.
   

 \* Define application, data, integration, semantic and AI architecture.
   

 \* Design the canonical semantic registry and concept/version model.
   

 \* Define architecture for ontology and knowledge\-graph components.
   

 \* Design workflow architecture for proposal, review, approval, escalation and deprecation.
   

 \* Define APIs and integration patterns for enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Data \& Semantic Architecture
   

  

 \* Design semantic models for business concepts, relationships, formulas and dependencies.
   

 \* Define metadata, lineage and provenance architecture.
   

 \* Design mechanisms for identifying conflicting definitions.
   

 \* Define semantic impact\-analysis architecture.
   

 \* Establish standards for canonical definitions and version management.
   

  

 AI Architecture
   

  

 \* Design AI/LLM components for:
   

 \* Semantic similarity
   

 \* Concept matching
   

 \* Conflict detection
   

 \* Regulatory document analysis
   

 \* Impact analysis
   

 \* AI\-assisted governance
   

 \* Define appropriate use of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG and knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop controls so AI recommendations do not automatically become authoritative definitions.
   

 \* Define evaluation, explainability and guardrail mechanisms.
   

  

 Enterprise Integration
   

  

 Design integration patterns with:
   

  

 \* Snowflake
   

 \* Databricks
   

 \* Power BI
   

 \* Tableau
   

 \* Collibra / Alation
   

 \* Data catalogs
   

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs
   

 \* Existing Claims, Underwriting and Finance systems
   

  

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 \* Create HLD and LLD architecture documentation.
   

 \* Produce architecture diagrams using Draw.io, Lucidchart or Mermaid.
   

 \* Create API, integration and data\-flow specifications.
   

 \* Participate in technical discussions with client stakeholders.
   

 \* Guide engineering teams during implementation.
   

 \* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks.
   

 \* Make technology and architectural trade\-off decisions.
   

  

 Required Technical Skills
   

  

 Must Have:
   

  

 \* 8\+ years of enterprise solution architecture experience.
   

 \* Strong experience with data platforms and enterprise integration.
   

 \* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Metadata Management.
   

 \* Experience with cloud architecture — AWS, Azure or GCP.
   

 \* Strong SQL and data architecture knowledge.
   

 \* REST APIs and event\-driven architecture.
   

 \* Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
   

 \* Experience integrating BI platforms such as Power BI/Tableau.
   

 \* Understanding of ontology, semantic models or knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture and LLM\-based applications.
   

 \* Experience with security, RBAC and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have:
   

  

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.
   

 \* RAG and vector databases.
   

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.
   

 \* Insurance, Banking, Financial Services or Risk domain experience.
   

  

 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Solution Architect will be responsible for producing:
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture
   

 2\. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
   

 3\. High\-Level Architecture (HLD)
   

 4\. Low\-Level Architecture (LLD)
   

 5\. Semantic/Knowledge Graph Architecture
   

 6\. AI/LLM Architecture
   

 7\. Integration Architecture
   

 8\. Security Architecture
   

 9\. API Architecture
   

 10\. Data Flow \& Sequence Diagrams
   

 11\. Deployment Architecture
   

 12\. Technology Selection \& Trade\-off Analysis
   

 13\. POC Architecture
   

 14\. Implementation Roadmap
   

 15\. Technical Standards for Engineering Teams
   

  

 Key Question We Expect the Architect to Solve
   

  

 The architect should be able to answer:
   

  

 How do we take an approved business definition such as “Loss Ratio”, represent it as a canonical semantic object, map it to regulatory requirements, detect conflicting implementations in Snowflake/Power BI/ML systems, perform impact analysis when the definition changes, and propagate the approved version across the enterprise — while keeping humans accountable for the final decision?
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can operate at both levels:
   

  

 Business → Architecture → Engineering
   

  

 and can confidently sit with:
   

  

 CDO / CFO / CRO → Data Governance → Enterprise Architects → Data Scientists → Data Engineers → Developers
   

  

 and convert the business requirement into an executable technical architecture.

 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. title: Blockchain Developer
description:
An entry\-level position for candidates with strong fundamentals in blockchain concepts and programming, eager to build hands\-on experience in smart contract development and dApp integration on EVM\-compatible chains.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Assist in writing, testing, and deploying smart contracts on BNB Chain (Solidity)
* Support integration of frontend interfaces with smart contracts using Web3 libraries (ethers.js/web3\.js)
* Write unit tests for contracts using frameworks like Hardhat or Foundry
* Help debug and document contract behavior, gas usage and transaction flows
* Participate in code reviews and learn secure coding practices for smart contracts
* Assist with wallet integration (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and basic authentication flows (e.g., SIWE)
* Collaborate with backend and frontend teams to understand API/data requirements



  





**Required Skills** 



* Solid understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus, gas, transactions, wallets)
* Solid proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (async/await, working with APIs/JSON, basic TS typing); familiarity with ethers.js or web3\.js is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Solidity (academic projects, bootcamps, or personal projects acceptable)
* Understanding of EVM basics and how smart contracts interact with the chain
* Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
* Strong communication skills and ability to work in a small, fast\-moving startup team
* Curiosity about financial markets, trading systems, or decentralized finance
* Comfortable with ambiguity and iterative development in a growing product



  





**Good to Have** 



* Personal projects or GitHub contributions involving smart contracts (even testnet deployments)
* Exposure to Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, or Remix
* Basic understanding of DeFi concepts (AMMs, liquidity pools, DEXs)
* Familiarity with React/Next.js for dApp frontends
* Coursework or certifications in blockchain development



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Strong problem\-solving ability and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced startup environment



  





**Selection Process will consist of three rounds** 



1. Primary evaluation will be executed through comprehensive, hands\-on programming assessments on the day of interview.
2. A formal code review followed by a rigorous technical discussion regarding the submitted codebase will be conducted.
3. A week\-long practical assessment involving a specific development assignment will be administered to evaluate candidate performance.



  





 Only final year students who can contribute full time will be considered for internship opportunities. Academic records and outstanding backlogs will not influence the selection process. Advancement in the evaluation process is contingent upon the successful demonstration of fundamental hands\-on programming skills.
